Document ID: PPB-SOP-2026-V1 
Version: 1.0 
Effective Date: February 1, 2026 
Status: Active 
 
SOP 001: Employee Onboarding (Front-line Service) 
Objective: To ensure all new Front-line Service Associates, Shift Leads, and Hotline 
Cooks are correctly integrated into the HRIS and trained on safety standards. 
+1 
Workflow Steps: 
1. Identity Verification: The General Manager (GM) must collect a valid Work Permit 
(for minors) or Form I-9 documentation within 24 hours of hire. 
+1 
2. System Entry: The Regional HR Representative enters employee data into the HRIS, 
assigning a unique Employee ID, Role, and Location tag (e.g., US-GA-ATL). 
+2 
3. Handbook Acknowledgment: The new hire must read the PPB Employee 
Handbook and sign the Acknowledgment and Confidentiality Agreement. 
+1 
4. Sanitation Training: All employees handling food must complete the ServSafe® 
Food Handler Course within 30 days.

SOP 002: Formal Grievance Filing 
Objective: To provide a structured process for employees to report workplace concerns or 
policy violations. 
+1 
Workflow Steps: 
1. Initial Report: The employee completes Form 102-B (Grievance Intake), detailing 
the incident, date, and any witnesses. 
+2 
2. Supervisor Review: The form is submitted to the Shift Lead. If the grievance 
involves the Shift Lead, it is submitted directly to the General Manager. 
+1 
3. Investigation Phase: The General Manager or HR Representative conducts a 
confidential investigation, interviewing all parties involved.

SOP 003: Requesting Paid Time Off (PTO) / Vacation 
Objective: To manage staffing levels across Georgia, New York, and Virginia locations 
while honoring employee leave entitlements. 
+1 
Workflow Steps: 
1. Eligibility Check: The employee verifies their accrued balance via the POS system. 
Full-time employees begin accruing after 6 months (Exempt) or 1 year (Non-
Exempt). 
+1

SOP 004: Emergency Shift Swap 
Objective: To maintain operational continuity when an employee is unable to work due to 
illness or emergency. 
+1 
Workflow Steps: 
1. Notification: The employee must call the General Manager or Manager on Duty at 
least four (4) hours before their shift starts. 
2. Replacement Search: The employee uses the internal directory to contact other 
employees with the same Role (e.g., another Hotline Cook) to find a replacement.
